Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1987
ACT IV OF 1987
SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT 1987
An Act further to amend the Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette to of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I , 15th June, 1987]
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Service Tribunals (Amendment)
Act, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Act LXX of 1973

ACT IV OF 1987
ACT IV OF 1987
SERVICE TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT 1987
An Act further to amend the Service Tribunals Act, 1973
[Gazette to of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I , 15th June, 1987]
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
LXX of 1973.--In the Service Tribunals Act, 1973 (LXX of 1973), in section
3, in subsection (3), in clause (b), for the words "not exceeding
three", the words "not less than three" shall be substituted.
